description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities : text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.

Role Responsibilities :

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.

Skills & Competencies :

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.

Requirements :

  • Bachelor's degree / diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI / ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm / high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.

What We Offer :

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Client Services Representative
description:
Mobility Care Associate

Job Type : Full-time, Freelancer Position

Location : Remote - Brazil - Work from home

  • Resumes must be submitted in English for consideration

On behalf of our client, we are seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven professional with excellent communication skills to join the Mindglobal team as a Mobility Care Associate.

Mindglobal , listed in Gartner's Market Guide, offers corporate TEM (Telecom Expense Management) solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises around the world.

Position Overview

As a Mobility Care Associate for Mindglobal, you are responsible for providing customer and technical assistance and support related to mobile device systems, hardware, software, company and carrier processes, and client procedures.

You will respond to queries by inbound phone call, email and as assigned, respond in a timely and professional manner, isolate issues and requests, and determine and implement a resolution as per client specific company procedures. This position is responsible for general customer service and completion of our clients' day-to-day tasks within measurable SLA metrics.

What you'll do

  • Quickly and professionally answer inbound client calls according to each client's preferred greeting and nomenclature
  • Respond to requests for assistance sent by email and received by our Helpdesk Ticketing solution professionally and using appropriate templates, verbiage and guidelines, and within each client's desired response SLA
  • Understand, access, and efficiently use carrier portals and other tools
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients' supported hardware, Mindglobal tools and carrier systems
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients' supported MDM and related systems, Mindglobal published client- and inside-facing tools, and carrier portals
  • Research process, policy and procedure questions using available informational resources
  • Using appropriate and professional grammar and communication skills, advise client employees on appropriate action(s), timelines, outcomes, etc.
  • Follow Mindglobal's standard help desk procedures according to each client's agreements, preferences and processes as noted in the KB, and as may be advised by MCM / CM and Helpdesk management
  • Ensure 100% of your client-related work is entered, tracked and documented in our Helpdesk Ticketing system correctly
  • Provide guidance to clients' employees on proper use of Mindglobal specific websites and tools
  • Understand and explain client-specific processes and procedures as well as carrier specific data to clients' employees
  • Refer and redirect non-Helpdesk requests to appropriate resource(s)
  • Identify and elevate situations requiring urgent attention and to the most appropriate resource
  • Stay current with industry trends, mobile technologies, internal systems and information, changes and updates
  • Proper and appropriate use of PC / Laptop and related equipment for Mindglobal's purposes
  • Proper and appropriate use of Mindglobal's electronic tools and resources for Mindglobal' purposes

Who you are

  • Proficient and professional / native level English speaker and writer
  • Able to multi-task and juggle a large volume of tasks
  • Consistently reliable: able to be on time and present when scheduled
  • Professional behavior in the workplace, remotely, and anywhere your Mindglobal affiliation is known
  • Excellent communication skills – verbal and written
  • Self-motivated to be effective with minimal supervision
  • Detail, process and results oriented
  • Ability to avoid distraction and consistently work throughout a scheduled shift
  • Previous experience in mobile / wireless industry a plus

What Mindglobal offers

  • Career Growth – Mindglobal prioritizes internal promotions.
  • Remote Flexibility – Work from home in Brazil.
  • Company Culture – A collaborative and supportive team environment.

Job Type : Full-time, Contract position

This is a freelancer position.

Benefits (such as healthcare, paid time off or 13th month pay) are not provided.

You will be an independent direct contractor ("freelancer") with Mindglobal and paid hourly for time worked.

You will be scheduled to work 40 hours per week and as a contractor can choose your time off and holidays.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

description:
Técnico de Enfermagem - Centro Cirúrgico

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Há 86 anos, a Fundação José Silveira mantém o olhar voltado para o futuro, reinventando suas práticas em um mundo imprevisível, sem perder de vista suas raízes sólidas naquilo que é a origem do propósito: cuidar da saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

Com isso, buscamos pessoas conectadas ao novo que venham contribuir com o constante crescimento e a perpetuação do nosso legado.

Junte-se ao nosso propósito!

Sua rotina como técnico de enfermagem será:

  • Auxiliar no preparo da sala cirúrgica/obstétrico, segundo cada caso específico, no provimento dos materiais necessários à realização de cada ato cirúrgico, conforme programação informada;
  • Receber o paciente, conferir pulseira de identificação conforme protocolo de cirurgia e parto seguro e certificar-se de que está devidamente preparado, encaminhá-lo para a sala e auxiliar no transporte da maca para a mesa cirúrgica/obstétrica e vice-versa;
  • Auxiliar na realização dos procedimentos pré-cirúrgico /obstétrico e anestésicos, posicionando o paciente e fornecendo os materiais necessários no decorrer de sua realização;
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao paciente durante a sua permanência no Centro, tendo em vista o seu bem-estar físico e psíquico, e auxiliar no seu encaminhamento ao setor de destino, após liberação do médico;
  • Executar as solicitações médicas e da Enfermeira, segundo orientações específicas e definidas;
  • Realizar controle de materiais esterilizados disponíveis para a realização de procedimentos, verificando sempre a data de validade, conforme rotina específica do setor;
  • Conferir o instrumental utilizado após cada ato cirúrgico/obstétrico e acondicioná-lo para fins de remessa para lavagem e esterilização;
  • Preencher as notas de sala segundo procedimentos definidos, tendo em vista a correta apropriação dos materiais utilizados e a confiabilidade na emissão da conta hospitalar correspondente;
  • Registrar os procedimentos realizados no prontuário, conforme procedimentos definidos, tendo em vista disponibilizar as informações necessárias para a continuidade do trabalho.
  • Manusear sistema PEP com prontuário eletrônico.
  • Curso técnico em enfermagem concluído;
  • Registro Coren BA ativo e regularizado;
  • Experiência na área de enfermagem com atuação em centro cirúrgico;
  • Disponibilidade para plantões.

Os benefícios que você terá com a FJS:

  • Plano de saúde
  • Programa de saúde do colaborador
  • Step 2: Entrevista com o RH 2 Entrevista com o RH

Criada em 21 de fevereiro de 1937 pelo Professor José Silveira, a Fundação José Silveira (FJS) vem ampliando sua obra em um processo de crescimento sustentável, firmado no planejamento estratégico e foco nos melhores resultados. Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

É o que demonstra o trabalho de referência das nossas unidades em áreas como combate à tuberculose, assistência neonatal, parto humanizado, tratamento do câncer de mama e reabilitação de pacientes com deficiências neuropsicomotoras, intelectuais e autismo. Por ano, são mais de 1,2 milhão de atendimentos realizados. A FJS promove, ainda, ações de prevenção e promoção da saúde e socioambientais voltadas às comunidades de Salvador e de municípios do interior da Bahia, contribuindo para a melhoria dos indicadores sociais e de saúde no estado.

title: [TEMPORÁRIA] Engenheiro de Dados - Sênior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados Sênior | Temporária A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão: Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Ser a pessoa responsável por transformar dados brutos em informações acessíveis e confiáveis, conectando a área técnica às necessidades de negócio e garantindo que as soluções construídas sustentem a tomada de decisão estratégica da empresa.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Criar e evoluir processos de arquitetura de dados;
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas e comunicá-las ao time de dados;
  • Elaborar desenhos de solução e propor melhorias;
  • Gerar especificações técnicas e documentações das soluções;
  • Fomentar a reutilização de componentes e o repasse de conhecimento entre squads;
  • Elaborar PoCs (Provas de Conceito) para validação de soluções;
  • Otimizar processos de ETL;
  • Disseminar melhores práticas de uso e governança de dados;
  • Contribuir em projetos de migração e integração de dados;
  • Participar de discussões baseadas em dados, apoiando decisões estratégicas.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência com tecnologias Microsoft Azure (Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Cosmos DB, SQL Database, Data Lake Storage);
  • Vivência em criação de desenhos de solução e modelagem de dados (relacionais e não relacionais);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI;
  • Conhecimento em governança e segurança de dados, aplicando políticas e processos eficazes;
  • Capacidade de elaborar documentação técnica e arquitetural;
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho colaborativo com diferentes áreas;
  • Interesse contínuo em aprender e se atualizar em novas tecnologias;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com integrações de dados complexas;
  • Experiência com Big Data, utilizando ferramentas como Jupyter Notebook, Hadoop, R, Python e MapReduce.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Atuar na definição e implementação de arquiteturas de dados, tanto em Cloud quanto On-Premises;
  • Construir e manter estruturas de Data Lake e Data Warehouse;
  • Liderar tecnicamente times ou iniciativas de engenharia de dados;
  • Implementar boas práticas de governança e segurança da informação;
  • Possuir certificações Microsoft relevantes para a área (como Azure Data Engineer ou Azure Solutions Architect).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser;
  • Benefícios de alimentação e home office;
  • Day-off no aniversário;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers;
  • Saúde e bem-estar;
  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal;
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional);
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento;
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer;
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga.

O que nos diferencia? Carreira e desenvolvimento: Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills, oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo.

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

Inscrição Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui. Bate-papo com People Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura. Entrevista técnica com liderança Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências. Feedback final Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.

Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Manipulador de Saneantes
description:
Job description

A OSID – Obras Sociais Irmã Dulce é uma das maiores instituições filantrópicas do país, com cerca de 5,6 milhões de procedimentos ambulatoriais por ano, na Bahia, a usuários do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), idosos, pessoas com deficiência e com deformidades craniofaciais, pessoas em de rua, usuários de substâncias psicoativas e crianças e adolescentes em situação de risco social.

A entidade conta com um perfil de serviços único no Brasil, distribuídos em 21 núcleos que prestam assistência à população de baixa renda nas áreas de Saúde, Assistência Social, Pesquisa Científica, Ensino em Saúde, Educação e na preservação e difusão da história de sua fundadora, Santa Dulce dos Pobres.

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar a diluição e envase de produtos saneantes conforme instruções técnicas e tabelas padrão;
  • Higienizar e preparar bombonas, almotolias e frascos pra uso;
  • Identificar e rotular corretamente todos os produtos diluídos, com informações completas e legíveis;
  • Preencher e assinar, junto ao farmacêutico, a ficha técnica de manipulação;
  • Realizar armazenamento dos produtos recebidos e diluídos conforme as normas estabelecidas;
  • Registrar as medições da temperatura do ambiente de armazenamento e sala de manipulação;
  • Identificar e remover produtos com suspeita de contaminação, violação ou vencimento;
  • Realizar a entrega dos produtos saneantes nos setores hospitalares, com controle de protocolo de entrega e assinatura dos responsáveis;
  • Dispensar os produtos mediante solicitação via sistema, seguindo o fluxo interno de registro e conferência;
  • Recolher, separar e higienizar os materiais utilizados na manipulação;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e organização do ambiente de trabalho;
  • Utilizar corretamente os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) durante todas as atividades;
  • Acionar os dispositivos de segurança (lava-olhos e chuveiro de emergência) em caso de acidente com produtos químicos.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • 06 meses de experiência em cargos similares.

Additional information

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Alimentação no refeitório da empresa.

  • Conhecer e aplicar as práticas de consumo consciente e preservação dos recursos naturais, em conformidade com as políticas de SSMA da companhia, compreendendo os impactos e riscos ambientais, bem como se familiarizar com os procedimentos de atendimento a emergências.

Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo (obrigatório)
  • Técnico completo ou cursando em: Química e áreas correlatas (diferencial)
  • Vivência em pacote office e sistema SAP (desejável)

Se você tem as experiências e competências acima, estamos em busca de um profissional como você! Mas se você não se identificou com a vaga, compartilhe e faça a diferença!

Na Ypê, valorizamos o respeito e a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades que fazem cada pessoa única, incluindo: Pessoas com Deficiência, Raça e Etnia, Idade, Gênero, Crenças, Orientação sexual e Identidade de gênero. Desta forma convidamos todas as pessoas em nossos processos seletivos. #TodoMundoConta

Fundada em 1950, a Ypê é uma empresa 100% brasileira, líder no segmento de higiene e limpeza que há mais de 70 anos preza pelo bem-estar, qualidade de vida e saúde das pessoas.

Nossa cultura visa garantir os nossos valores de Cuidado, Honestidade, Humildade, Trabalho com disciplina, Senso de Dono, Simplicidade e Qualidade de ponta a ponta.

Com matriz localizada em Amparo, interior de São Paulo, conta com mais cinco unidades fabris: Salto (SP), Anápolis (GO), Goiânia (GO), Simões Filho (BA) e Itapissuma (PE).

Oferecemos um portfólio com diversas linhas de produtos, divididas em três categorias: limpeza da casa, cuidado com a roupa e higiene corporal.

Buscamos pessoas que transformam os ambientes, que vivem com otimismo e fazem sempre o melhor para os consumidores e para o negócio. Pessoas movidas pela inovação, que se adaptam, agem como donos, cumprem o que prometem e praticam ações que contribuem com o futuro da nossa gente e do planeta.

title: SA Supply Chain Operations Manager
description:
Lead the Supply Chain Center of Excellence (CoE) for South America, ensuring standardized, efficient and compliant processes across Direct and Indirect Purchasing, Business Office and Purchasing Systems. The role governs policies, processes and systems, secures audit and regulatory compliance, and provides performance visibility to management. A critical mandate is to lead, for South America, the business side of the I‑ERP program, driving the successful implementation and adoption of SAP S/4HANA and Ariba for Supply Chain and Purchasing, enabling data‑driven decisions and sustainable operational excellence.

Qualifications

Profile / Requirements

Education

  • University degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems or related field.
  • Post‑graduate degree or MBA is a plus.

Professional Experience

  • Solid experience in Supply Chain and/or Purchasing, preferably in a multinational and multi‑plant environment.
  • Proven track record in process governance, standardization and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross‑functional projects; prior ERP implementation experience (ideally SAP S/4HANA and/or Ariba) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with audits, compliance programs and policy/procedure management.

Technical and Functional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Purchasing and Supply Chain processes (Direct and Indirect).
  • Good understanding of ERP systems; hands‑on familiarity with SAP and e‑Procurement solutions (e.g., Ariba) is highly valued.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban or SAFe) in project delivery, including backlog management, sprint or increment planning, and iterative delivery.
  • Competence in process mapping and documentation tools; experience with KPI design and performance dashboards (e.g., Excel, Power BI or similar).
  • Solid analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.

Languages

  • Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish.

Fluency in English required for regional and global interaction.

Competencies and Behaviors

Aligned with Ford Behaviors – Focus, Excellence and Collaboration :

  • Focus
    • Sets clear priorities and focuses the organization on the highest‑value Supply Chain and I‑ERP outcomes for South America.
    • Translates strategy into an executable roadmap, ensuring resources and attention are directed to what matters most for customers and the business.
  • Excellence
    • Drives disciplined execution, process rigor and high standards in policies, audits, data quality and systems usage.
    • Uses data and structured problem‑solving to deliver continuous improvement in cost, quality, timing and compliance.
    • Champions best practices and lessons learned from audits and projects, embedding them into standard work.
  • Collaboration
    • Builds strong, trust‑based relationships across countries, plants and functions (Supply Chain, Purchasing, Finance, IT, global CoEs).
    • Facilitates cross‑functional alignment, resolves conflicts constructively and creates a “one team” mindset for I‑ERP and operational initiatives.
    • Communicates clearly and transparently, ensuring stakeholders are informed, engaged and heard.

Additional Behavioral Capabilities

  • Change Leadership: Guides teams through transformation, particularly digital and ERP changes, with strong emphasis on communication, training and user adoption.
  • Results Orientation: Delivers on commitments, manages priorities and deadlines, and ensures projects achieve expected outcomes in terms of cost, quality and timing.
  • Customer and Stakeholder Focus: Balances global standards with local needs; actively listens to internal customers and provides pragmatic, value‑adding solutions.
  • Integrity and Compliance Mindset: Acts as a role model for ethical behavior, policy adherence and audit readiness.

Key Interfaces

  • Regional Purchasing, Supply Chain and Logistics teams
  • Plant and Country management in South America
  • Finance, Controlling and Compliance functions
  • Global Supply Chain and Purchasing Centers of Excellence
  • Global I‑ERP (SAP S/4HANA & Ariba) program team and IT organization
  • External auditors, consultants and solution providers (as needed)

#LI-FordArgentina

#LI-FD1

Responsibilities

Main Activities / Key Responsibilities

  • Process Governance and Standardization
    • Lead the definition, mapping, documentation and continuous improvement of end‑to‑end Direct and Indirect Purchasing processes across South America.
    • Ensure alignment with global standards, internal controls, legal and compliance requirements, harmonizing practices across countries and plants.
    • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for Supply Chain and Purchasing processes and drive corrective/improvement actions.
  • Policy, Procedure and Audit Management
    • Own and maintain regional Supply Chain and Purchasing policies, procedures, work instructions and standards, ensuring regular review and updates.
    • Plan, coordinate and support internal and external audits related to Purchasing (e.g., ISO9001, MCRP, SA DRIM, AFR campaigns, OIC Direct & Indirect Purchasing).
    • Lead the response to audit findings, define corrective actions, track implementation and embed lessons learned into processes and systems.
  • Business Office Leadership
    • Manage Business Office routines for South America Supply Chain, including governance calendars, meeting preparation and action follow‑up.
    • Consolidate and analyze performance data, preparing management reports, dashboards and executive presentations that provide clear visibility of results, risks and opportunities.
    • Support regional and global leadership in strategic planning, target setting and tracking of major initiatives.
  • Purchasing Systems Ownership
    • Act as regional business owner for Purchasing and Supply Chain systems and tools, in coordination with global process owners and IT.
    • Ensure robust system configuration, data quality, master data governance and proper access management.
    • Provide guidance and support to users, including issue resolution, enhancement requests and coordination of training needs.
  • I‑ERP (SAP S/4HANA & Ariba) Leadership – South America
    • Lead, from the business side, the South America implementation of SAP S/4HANA and Ariba for Supply Chain and Purchasing (I‑ERP).
    • Coordinate the collection and validation of business requirements, process design and solution blueprinting, ensuring fit‑for‑purpose and standardized processes.
    • Oversee integration testing, user acceptance testing, data migration preparation and validation, cut‑over planning and post‑go‑live stabilization.
    • Develop and execute change‑management, communication and training plans to drive strong user adoption and realize expected benefits.
    • Act as key interface between regional business teams and global program/IT, ensuring timely issue resolution and decision‑making.
  • Stakeholder Management and Continuous Improvement
    • Coordinate cross‑functional and cross‑country teams (Purchasing, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, Plants and Corporate functions) to ensure consistent deployment of processes and systems.
    • Identify optimization opportunities in cost, quality, lead time, compliance and data reliability; prioritize and lead or sponsor related improvement projects.
    • Promote a culture of process discipline, digitalization and continuous improvement across the South America Supply Chain organization.

title: Deputy Chief Technology Officer (CTO) – AI & Engineering Strategy
description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are looking for a visionary Deputy CTO with deep experience transforming engineering processes through the strategic use of Artificial Intelligence (AI). The ideal candidate is a hands‑on leader who has successfully guided development teams toward higher velocity, quality, and operational excellence by introducing and optimizing AI‑powered practices.

In this role, you will help us refine, elevate, and scale our existing engineering processes, strengthening the connection between architectural governance, team growth, and customer‑facing technical leadership.

AI-Driven Development Transformation

  • Accelerate SDLC: Lead the adoption of Generative AI tools and coding assistants to reduce cycle times and eliminate repetitive engineering tasks drastically.
  • Measure Impact: Define and track KPIs related to AI adoption (e.g., velocity increase, code quality metrics, reduction in technical debt) to prove ROI.

  • Acompanhar indicadores específicos determinados pelo fabricante.

This position will be based in the Recife region. Amazon is looking for an Operations Manager to be based in our new Fulfillment Center in Recife. The Operations Manager has complete responsibility for all processes within a warehouse on a specified shift or across multiple shifts. Reporting to the Sr. Ops Manager, you will be directly responsible for a team of Area /Team Managers and their direct reports. You will work to continuously improve the functionality and level of service that we provide our customers, resulting in exceeded productivity goals and delivery against our customer promises.

As the Operations Manager you will:

  • Lead and supervise a team of Area Managers and hourly associates in outbound and/or inbound operations for the night shift.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Manage and drive staffing plans, schedules, quality initiatives, performance levels, process change initiatives, and other Process Improvement/ Six Sigma initiatives to enable Operations and to attain the Business Plan.
  • Manage a team of many employees within a very fast-paced/ time-critical and demanding environment. This will include the setup and implementation of career development plans for all your Direct Reports, i.e. the Area Managers.
  • Manage a shift directly and a major process directly or indirectly – becoming a subject matter expert in your area.
  • Set / clarify requirements and expectations for Area Managers and Team Leaders.
  • Work closely with other support teams (HR, Financial Manager, Facilities Manager, Safety & Security Manager, IT Manager) to build and secure support and resources for projects and initiatives.
  • Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and procedures.
  • Implement change and/or develop new processes as required.
  • Participate from time to time in cross-functional Process and Business Improvement projects.
  • Candidates must be flexible to work weekends and/or overnight shifts regularly.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Administration, Economy, Data Processing, Computer Engineering, Mathematics or any correlated degrees.
  • Experience managing teams.
  • Employee and performance management experience.
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays.
  • Fluent Portuguese and Advanced English.
  • Operations or Logistics experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or Post Graduate Degree
  • Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing and process improvement
  • SQL and Advanced Excel

  • Identificar oportunidades para melhorar a eficiência e eficácia dos processos contábeis da empresa, implementando melhores práticas e sistemas automatizados sempre que possível.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as mudanças nas normas contábeis e regulamentações fiscais, participando de treinamentos e programas de desenvolvimento profissional para aprimorar suas habilidades e conhecimentos.
  • Representar a empresa na análise das informações contábeis, fiscais e de departamento de pessoal.

FORMAÇÃO/HABILIDADES ESPECIAIS/EXPERIÊNCIA

title: Sr. Process Manager, Outbound - Fulfillment Center ACES, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES)
description:
Sr. Process Manager, Outbound - Fulfillment Center ACES, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES)

As a Process Specialist for Amazon's Fulfillment Centers, you will be the guardian of quality control at Earth's most customer-centric company! More specifically, you will be responsible for the adoption and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across our FC network.

You will work with teams across Operations, Learning, Finance, and other supporting functions in order to find defects and opportunities, measure performance, and track changes. As an ACES Process Specialist, you are the Subject Matter Expert on all processes and are expected to catalog and share this expertise with your stakeholders in a clear and scalable manner.

Key job responsibilities

  • being the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on all operational processes;
  • leading process integration efforts at our Fulfillment Centers (FCs);
  • leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, Kaizens, Root Cause Analysis, etc.;
  • owning and managing change on a granular level;
  • performing audits to ensure continuous SOP adoption and eliminate defects and deviations;
  • work with teams both inside and outside of Operations to identify opportunities for improvement;
  • make sure that we are always delivering the best possible service to our customers.

A day in the life

You will be working closely with all Ops teams to offer support and expertise and gain an insight into bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. Some of these teams include:

  • FC Ops
  • Middle Mile and Last Mile teams
  • Learning
  • Finance
  • HR
  • Loss Prevention

You will also work with your counterparts in other geographies to benchmark our processes and ensure conformity with Amazon Standard Work.

About the team

The Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) team is a team of highly qualified individuals whose main goal is to safeguard the quality and productivity of our operations and find ways to continuously improve and innovate. We do this by keeping a close eye on metrics, making sure that we are constantly raising the bar on performance and efficiency. We are also responsible for the adoption of new technology and procedures as well as supporting our peers with subject matter expertise.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience with program or project management.
  • Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams.
  • Experience defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics.
  • Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL.
  • Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements.
  • Lean Six Sigma experience (certification a plus).
  • Advanced English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience.
  • Experience driving complex process improvements.
  • Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization.
  • Experience building processes, project management and schedules.
  • Black Belt certification.

title: Postdoctoral Project Research Scientist
description:
Job Title: Postdoctoral Project Research Scientist – McTernan lab

Reporting to: Charlie McTernan, Group Leader

Contract: full‑time, fixed term (15 months) on Crick terms and conditions of employment.

Closing date: 3rd December at 23:59.

About us

The Francis Crick Institute is Europe’s largest biomedical research institute under one roof. Our world‑class scientists and staff collaborate on vital research to help prevent, diagnose and treat illnesses such as cancer, heart disease, infectious diseases and neurodegenerative conditions.

About the role

The McTernan Group are a synthetic chemistry group working in supramolecular and biological chemistry, and nanotechnology. We look at how we can apply Supramolecular Chemistry in Biological settings.

Details of research projects currently being undertaken can be seen at: mcternanresearchgroup.com

The Project

This project is a translational and basic research project, looking to apply supramolecular chemistry to create mechanically interlocked peptides, with targeted applications in supramolecular drug delivery systems.

What you will be doing

  • Investigating research questions and developing specific research project(s) under guidance from Group Leader.
  • Providing specialist advice and guidance, sharing knowledge and expertise for the benefit of others.
  • Providing a significant contribution to the production of research papers for publication, presenting findings to group members and other internal and external audiences.
  • Develop ideas for generating research income, and present detailed research proposals.
  • Act as a source of information and advice to other members of the group on scientific protocols and experimental techniques.
  • Have a pro‑active approach to the management of health and safety protocols and play a leading role within the group in ensuring compliance with safety policy.
  • Acting as a leader within the group, helping to maintain a collaborative, kind, and supportive research environment; helping group members to achieve their potential.

About you

  • PhD in Synthetic Organic Chemistry and/or Chemical Biology and/or Supramolecular Chemistry and/or Solid‑Phase Peptide Synthesis or related field.
  • Expertise in organic synthesis at a high level.
  • Track record of writing papers as evidenced by impactful publications in refereed journals or submitted manuscripts.
  • Evidence of data presentation at scientific meetings.
  • Evidence of ability to supervise and educate junior co‑workers and take part in joint projects.
  • Be willing to lead the organisation and management of the laboratory, assuming a share of group responsibilities, showing excellent organisational and leadership skills.
  • A pro‑active approach to management of laboratory safety.

*Minimum requirements

About Working at the Crick

At the Francis Crick Institute, we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving innovation and scientific discovery. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to succeed, regardless of their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We actively encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ethnicities, abilities, and experiences. O estágio na área da Controladoria está à sua espera! Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe inovadora e apaixonada, pronta para transformar a mobilidade global, seu lugar é aqui. Na Conti, você terá a oportunidade de encarar desafios, trabalhar em equipe, se desenvolver e ver suas ideias se tornarem realidade.

Aqui na Conti, essas são as principais atividades dos estagiários área da Controladoria:

  • Participar dos processos de forecast e actual no fechamento mensal para as áreas de logística, manutenção, projetos, produção, entre outras.

  • Apoiar análises de tendência de custos, atualizando informações nos sistemas para subsidiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.

  • Manter e aprimorar dashboards financeiros e operacionais no Power BI e Excel, integrando dados dos sistemas utilizados na Continental.

  • Contribuir para a otimização de relatórios, automação de planilhas e integração de dados financeiros, buscando eficiência nas rotinas da área.

  • Realizar follow-up com líderes de projetos CAPEX/OPEX e responsáveis por centros de custo sobre o planejamento dos gastos.

  • Apoiar a criação, atualização e controle de elementos PEPs, bem como relatórios financeiros de projetos CAPEX/OPEX e análises de variação.

  • Realizar análises e conciliações entre diferentes sistemas e relatórios, garantindo consistência dos dados.

  • Apoiar o acompanhamento e a reconciliação de dados de scrap entre sistemas.

  • Apoiar a análise e conciliação de inventário e materiais em processo, garantindo a integridade das informações.

Informações adicionais

O QUE OFERECEMOS:

  • Wellhub para diferentes modalidades esportivas;
  • Transporte Fretado;
  • Desconto na compra de pneus;
  • Sala de aleitamento materno;
  • Programa de Apoio Conti;
  • Estacionamento no local;
  • Massoterapia no local;
  • Fisioterapia no local;

Pronto para dirigir com a Continental? Dê o primeiro passo e preencha o formulário online.

Qualificações

O QUE PRECISA TER

  • Cursando nível superior em Administração ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar por até 2 anos;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);

  • Disponibilidade para estagiar presencialmente na fábrica de Camaçari – BA, de segunda a sexta das 07h às 14h.

VOCÊ SE DESTACA SE TIVER

  • Inglês em nível Intermediário ou Avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.

Descrição da empresa

A Continental desenvolve tecnologias e serviços pioneiros para a mobilidade sustentável e conectada de pessoas e seus bens. Fundada em 1871, a empresa de tecnologia oferece soluções seguras, eficientes, inteligentes e acessíveis para veículos, máquinas, tráfego e transporte. Em 2021, a Continental gerou vendas de € 33,8 bilhões e emprega atualmente mais de 190 mil pessoas em 58 países e mercados. Em 8 de outubro de 2021, celebrou-se o aniversário de 150 anos da empresa.

Com seu portfólio premium da divisão de carros, caminhões, ônibus, veículos de duas rodas e pneus especiais, o setor Tires do grupo proporciona soluções inovadoras na área da tecnologia de pneus. Os produtos e serviços inteligentes relacionados a pneus e a promoção da sustentabilidade completam o portfólio de produtos. Para os revendedores especializados e gerentes de frotas, o setor Tires oferece sistemas digitais de monitoramento e gerenciamento de pneus, além de outros serviços, com o objetivo de garantir o funcionamento das frotas e aumentar sua eficiência. Com os pneus fornecidos, a Continental faz uma contribuição significativa para a mobilidade segura, eficiente e ecológica.

Amazon is looking for staffing leads (recruiters/procurement) that are motivated to lead mass recruitment programs for Amazon's logistics sites (Customer Fulfillment, Amazon Transportation Services, Amazon Logistics, or Global Specialty Fulfillment). Staffing Leads take the lead in securing personnel to achieve smooth receipt and shipment at logistics hubs. They are highly motivated and flexible to drive operational excellence for Workforce Staffing (WFS) with its major business partners.

A successful candidate must demonstrate strong consulting skills, exceptional ability to influence, organizational expertise, strong verbal and written communication skills, and a passion for building data driven programs that improve business operations. They are self‑motivated, solutions‑oriented, comfortable with ambiguity, and innovative in developing best‑in‑class programs.

  • Staffing Leads input optimal information to teams that plan and execute recruitment plans (posting job advertisements, etc.).
  • Progress in securing personnel will be shared through regular meetings with those responsible for logistics base operations. If issues arise, the team will work together to resolve them.
  • Staffing Leads secure the necessary personnel through negotiations with temporary staffing agencies as well as fill Amazon direct roles.
  • Have a rigorous approach to problem solving and analytics, as well as produce, interpret, and draw conclusions from data.
  • Provide expertise, and technical/operational guidance to the stakeholders and operations leaders.
  • Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, as well as balance business needs versus constraints.
  • Establish business priorities, identifying and communicating risks and mitigation plans in collaboration with stakeholders; developing and maintaining goals, milestones and completion dates.
  • Be comfortable presenting ideas to senior level stakeholders, receptive of feedback and quick to apply changes.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
  • Have a combination of practical and intellectual skills, as well as ability to rapidly shift and adapt to different tasks that vary between complex analyses, hands‑on projects, and project management.
  • Regular opportunities to participate and work with team members around the world in English though in person/remote meetings, reports, emails, etc.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Identify potential issues in the hiring process and ensure corrective actions/escalations are completed.
  • Deep dive operational metrics to improve performance, trouble‑shoot defects, and create remedial actions to meet goals.
  • Interact directly with Business Analysts involved in operational planning and engage in seek to understand discussions related to metric methodology and validation.
  • Perform customer/partner needs and task analysis, scope projects, and evaluate existing processes to propose solutions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience with HR processes and systems.
  • Knowledge of HR systems.
  • Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with process improvement and stakeholder management.
  • Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards.

Somos um grupo multimarcas que atua na comercialização de veículos novos, seminovos, acessórios, consórcios, frota, seguros e pós-vendas realizado na nossa rede de concessionárias além do serviço de locação (mobilidade).

title: DESIGNER GRÁFICO - REMOTO
description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.

WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.

WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency

BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands

WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.

With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

Faça parte da 1ª PPP em Diagnóstico por Imagem da Bahia!

Essa é a sua chance de crescer em uma empresa que transforma a saúde pública com propósito e cuidado de verdade.

Na RBD Imagem , há 10 anos dedicamos nossa energia a levar diagnósticos rápidos e precisos para milhares de pacientes do SUS. Estamos presentes em 13 unidades hospitalares espalhadas pela Bahia — de Salvador a Guanambi — fazendo a diferença todos os dias.

Aqui, valorizamos o talento, o compromisso e o olhar humano. Acreditamos que cada colaborador é peça fundamental para entregar um atendimento que vai além do exame: um atendimento que acolhe, respeita e cuida.

Se você quer fazer parte de um time que une tecnologia de ponta com o calor do cuidado humano, aqui é o seu lugar.

  • Supervisionar e organizar as atividades dos técnicos de enfermagem, garantindo a segurança e qualidade da assistência ao paciente;
  • Administrar medicamentos e tratamentos prescritos por médico (administração e preparo de contraste/medicamento se necessário);
  • Realizar consultas de Enfermagem/triagem quando necessário;
  • Assegurar aos pacientes, durante o atendimento, serviços que lhes proporcione segurança técnica humanizada/bem estar, mantendo um ambiente psicológico e físico que contribuam para a satisfação do cliente;

Requisitos e qualificações

Consideramos Como Obrigatório

  • Disponibilidade para atuar em plantões diaristas ou 12x36;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar nos centros de bioimagem;
  • Coren ativo.

O que você precisa saber para se dar bem nesse processo?

  • Você deve reconhecer a importância de trabalhar com propósito, afinal, estamos envolvidos na missão de salvar vidas;
  • É fundamental que você apresente suas experiências e expectativas de forma clara;
  • Priorize a honestidade, sinceridade e espontaneidade, não buscamos a perfeição;
  • Antes de uma possível entrevista, esteja bem preparado, faça uma pesquisa sobre a RBD Imagem;

Informações adicionais

Benefícios Para Cuidar De Você

  • Vale Transporte e Alimentação;
  • TotalPass para incentivar seu bem-estar;
  • Plano de Saúde SulAmérica 100% custeado pela empresa;
  • Plano Odontológico MetLife com mensalidade básica paga pela empresa;
  • Seguro de Vida SulAmérica integralmente custeado;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Starbem Atendimento Online;
  • Aplicativo Namu.

Etapas do processo

  • Etapa 1: Cadastro

  • Etapa 3: Teste de Racionicio Verbal essencial
  • Etapa 4: Entrevista com o RH
  • Etapa 5: Entrevista com o Gestor

Vem transformar a saúde com a gente!

Onde propósito e cuidado andam juntos

Se você é apaixonado por cuidar de pessoa s e acredita no poder do que faz, seu lugar pode ser com a gente . Na Rede Brasileira de Diagnóstico, você encontra um ambiente de desenvolvimento , inovação e oportunidade real de crescimento .

Nossa jornada já é trilhada por mais de 600 colaboradores, que atuam em 13 unidades hospitalares espalhadas por toda a Bahia. Com tecnologia de ponta e compromisso com a vida, já realizamos mais de 3,5 milhões de exames para pacientes do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS).

Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que acredita no acolhimento, na força do coletivo e na excelência. Juntos, vamos seguir cuidando de pessoas e transformando o presente e o futuro da saúde pública no Bahia.

Nós somos o Grupo NewChase e crescemos juntos!

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar atendimento ao cliente que adentrar no showroom, aplicando a metodologia do padrão da montadora, através de uma postura simpática, entusiasmada e cordial com conhecimentos sedimentados dos produtos, identificando as necessidades do cliente e apresentando o mix de produtos e benefícios com o objetivo de garantir o fechamento do negócio e atingir os objetivos quantitativos e qualitativos, assim como as metas estabelecidas pela Diretoria Comercial.

title: Creative Production Lead
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

About Olly Olly

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we're blending technology and real-world expertise to empower small businesses across the U.S. like never before.

We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That's why we're on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and grow sustainably without the hassle.

The Olly Olly platform complements our hands‑on service perfectly : it's no‑nonsense, easy‑to‑use software that helps local businesses streamline operations, drive leads, and maximize revenue with minimal effort so they can focus on what they do best.

Why We Need You

You have the eye. You can look at a website for five seconds and know whether it builds trust or destroys it. You see the logo that looks like a 2008 Fiverr special, the stock photo that screams "we didn't try," the typography that signals cheap. And it bothers you. Physically.

We're building a production team that creates websites, logos, and visual assets for 4,000+ local service businesses—contractors, plumbers, attorneys, HVAC companies. These businesses live or die by how professional they look online. Your job is to make sure everything we ship makes them look like the best option in their market.

As Creative Production Lead , you'll manage a team of designers who assemble websites from content, photos, and structured data. You're not just assigning tickets. You're inspecting work daily, catching the details that kill credibility, coaching your team to see what you see, and refusing to let "good enough" out the door.

You can also DO the work yourself. When a logo needs to be created or fixed, you're not waiting for someone else. When a layout isn't working, you can open the file and make it better. You lead by example because you're a designer first, manager second.

The Impact You'll Have

  • Quality is your obsession. You review completed work daily—not for completion, but for excellence. You catch the weak logo, the amateur photo crop, the layout that buries the CTA, the color palette that feels dated. Nothing ships unless it meets your standards.
  • You inspect, you coach, you elevate. You're providing specific feedback on real work : "This logo doesn't work because the type is fighting the icon." "This hero image undermines trust—the lighting looks fake." "This layout guides the eye away from what matters." You're building your team's taste through detailed critiques.
  • You stay fluid. What looked great two years ago looks tired today. You're constantly studying what's working across industries, updating standards, killing approaches that stopped converting. When you spot a pattern that works, you train the team on it immediately.
  • You execute when needed. Logo needs a refresh? You can do it. Layout falling apart? You fix it. You're not above the work—you're the best at it.
  • You run production, not a gallery. This is high‑volume. Your team handles hundreds of sites and thousands of updates monthly. You understand that speed and quality aren't opposites—they require discipline, systems, and people who give a damn.

What We Really Need From You

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years in visual design with a portfolio that demonstrates genuine taste—not just competence, but an eye for what converts vs. what just exists
  • 2+ years leading or managing a design team—you've held people to standards, given hard feedback, and developed talent
  • Hands‑on execution skills : you can create and refine logos, fix layouts, improve visual hierarchy yourself
  • Production experience : you've worked in environments where volume mattered—agencies, e‑commerce, high‑output teams
  • Quality obsession : you reject work that's "fine" because fine doesn't win

What Would Be Big Pluses

  • Background in advertising, branding agencies, or e‑commerce design
  • Experience with WordPress page builders (Elementor, WP Bakery, Divi, Gutenberg)—or willingness to learn fast
  • Understanding of conversion principles : what builds trust, what drives action
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems
  • Knowledge of SEO basics and how design choices impact performance

We’ll Teach You

  • Our specific tools and workflows
  • WordPress / Elementor if you don't know them (you'll pick it up in a week)
  • Our brand guidelines and quality standards
  • The local service business landscape

What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Salary : Competitive (based on experience and location)
  • Flexible work : 100% remote, core hours 8 AM – 5 PM EST for collaboration
  • Work‑life balance : 15 vacation days + U.S. holidays
  • Growth path : This role leads to Director of Creative Production or VP of Creative. You'll build the team, the systems, and the culture.
  • Real impact : Your standards directly determine whether 17,000+ small businesses look like winners or also‑rans.

Why Choose Us?

We're evolving from template‑driven agency work to genuinely differentiated design. You'll build a team culture where craft matters, where mediocrity gets rejected, and where the work actually helps small businesses compete.

Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here—and your unique perspective helps us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Analista do Produto Sr
description:
Job Description

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Produto Sênior – Otimização de Custos (Design-to-Cost) para integrar nosso time de Global Total Cost. Nesta posição estratégica, você será o elo crucial na gestão da eficiência de custos, liderando iniciativas Design-to-Cost desde as fases de pré-programa até o lançamento de novos produtos. Sua atuação focará em componentes críticos, como sistemas de transmissão (Driveline) – Semieixos ("Halfshafts"), Cardan ("Driveshaft") e Eixos Dianteiro e Traseiro ("Beam/Non-Beam/eBeam Axles") – e, eventualmente, estendendo-se a Sistemas de Suspensão, Freios e Direção. Colaborando estreitamente com as equipes globais de Compras, Desenvolvimento de Produto e Finanças, você atuará como um analista técnico de confiança, identificando e implementando oportunidades significativas de redução de custos e de melhoria da eficiência em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do produto.

O Analista de Produto Sênior será responsável por coordenar a melhoria da eficiência de custos durante o ciclo de desenvolvimento de novos veículos, abrangendo as fases de pré-programa até o lançamento. O foco é garantir o alinhamento de custos com o target do programa através de análises factuais e liderança de iniciativas multifuncionais.

Responsibilities

  • Liderança de Cost Loop: Responsável por planejar e conduzir eventos de Cost Loop (agenda, pre-work, decisões e deliverables), alinhando custos ao target do programa.
  • Gestão de Custos e Baseline: Manter e gerenciar a baseline de custos (BOM/surrogates vs. intenção do programa, piece price, logística, ferramental e overhead).
  • Análise e Suporte Técnico: Entender e suportar o desenvolvimento de estimativas (should-cost), análises por commodity, e apoiar propostas de engenharia (VA/VE - Value Analysis/Value Engineering).
  • Identificação de Oportunidades: Conduzir benchmarking/tear-down para mapear oportunidades de saving e identificar riscos de custos.
  • Suporte a Negociação: Apoiar a área de Compras fornecendo análises fact-based em negociações e cenários de sourcing.
  • Gestão e Reporting: Gerir o tracker de ações (donos, prazos, status), consolidar e reportar o status de custos desde o pré-programa até o lançamento para times funcionais e liderança.
  • Governança de Dados: Garantir a governança de dados, versionamento e aderência aos processos internos (ex.: PEL/GPDS).
  • Automação: Automatizar e visualizar dados utilizando ferramentas avançadas (Excel avançado/Power Query/Power BI) e preparar pacotes de decisão concisos.

Qualifications

  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de analisar dados complexos e métricas financeiras para tomar decisões que melhorem a eficiência de sistemas e peças utilizadas em veículos.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Forte capacidade de se comunicar eficazmente com as partes interessadas em todos os níveis da organização.
  • Habilidades de Negociação: Expertise em negociar com engenharia, finanças, fornecedores e compradores para garantir que as melhores decisões de custo sejam tomadas sem detrimento ao resultado ou qualidade.
  • Gerenciamento de Projetos: Competência comprovada em gerenciar projetos complexos que envolvem múltiplas equipes e regiões.
  • Língua: Inglês Fluente (Escrita e Oratória) é mandatório. A posição exige comunicação integralmente em Inglês em todas as atividades, incluindo e-mails, reuniões e apresentações para a alta liderança global.

Diferenciais (Desejável)

  • Adoção de Tecnologia: Capacidade de implementar ou utilizar tecnologias avançadas, como Inteligência Artificial (IA) e Aprendizado de Máquina (Machine Learning), para automatizar e aprimorar os processos de gestão de custos.

title: Vice President of Sales - LATAM
description:
About GTT

GTT is a leading networking and security as a service provider for multinational organizations, simply and securely connecting people and machines to data and applications – anywhere in the world. We serve thousands of organizations, bringing together the right people, partners and technology to reduce the burden on IT teams and solve the most pressing networking and security challenges. Built on our top‑ranked global Tier 1 network, GTT Envision is a single global technology platform to connect, orchestrate, virtualize and automate enterprise networks, enabling customers with consumable solutions to achieve business missions and meet ongoing demand when, where and how needed. Our portfolio includes SASE, SD‑WAN, security, internet, voice and other connectivity options, complemented by a suite of professional services and exceptional sales and support teams in local markets around the globe. We partner with our customers to deliver Greater Technology Together.

Role Summary

The VP, Sales - LATAM drives strategic market expansion for GTT by developing and nurturing high‑value, long‑term relationships with key Carrier, Wholesale, and Strategic Alliance partners across the Latin American region. This role focuses on ecosystem development, identifying and securing new business models, and creating sustainable revenue channels through partnerships, rather than direct transactional sales. The Manager will be responsible for defining and executing the strategic plan to significantly increase GTT's market presence and network reach in LATAM.

Job Scope and Stakeholder Engagement

This role serves as a strategic bridge between GTT's offerings and the LATAM carrier market.

  • External Focus: Primary interaction is with executive and strategic planning teams at Target Carrier Partners, Global Data Center Providers, and potential Channel Partners to establish commercial, network, and technology alliances.
  • Internal Collaboration: Works closely with Product, Strategy, Finance, and Legal to define partnership terms and new commercial models. Acts as the voice of the LATAM market to inform Sales Engineering and Network Planning on necessary infrastructure investments.

Duties And Responsibilities

This role's success is measured by strategic outcomes and long‑term pipeline growth, not immediate sales quota achievement.

  • Market Strategy & Penetration: Develop and execute a comprehensive LATAM Carrier Business Development plan, identifying white‑space opportunities, competitive threats, and potential strategic partners to secure GTT's long‑term competitive advantage.
  • Partnership Identification and Structuring: Proactively identify, qualify, and negotiate strategic agreements with major LATAM carriers (e.g., IXPs, Mobile Operators, Regional Tier 1/2 Carriers) to expand GTT's network footprint and service portfolio in the region.
  • Ecosystem Development: Cultivate a robust network of strategic channel and alliance partners to drive scalable, indirect distribution of GTT services.
  • Long‑Term Pipeline Generation: Establish a pipeline focused on multi‑year revenue potential stemming from new partnerships, joint ventures, and wholesale capacity swaps, ensuring sustainable growth.
  • Cultural and Business Acumen: Leverage deep regional knowledge and fluency in local business practices to effectively structure and manage relationships across diverse LATAM territories.
  • Reporting: Track and report on market penetration, new partnership launches, pipeline value of strategic deals, and the successful commercialization of new routes/services.

Required Experience / Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in a Business Development, Partnership Management, or Strategic Alliance role within the global telecommunications / technology sector focusing on the LATAM carrier market.
  • Demonstrated Success in Ecosystem Building: A proven track record of successfully identifying, negotiating, and launching complex, non‑standard commercial agreements (e.g., wholesale capacity swaps, joint GTM strategies, network peering).
  • Deep Regional Carrier Knowledge: Thorough understanding of the competitive landscape, regulatory environment, key contacts, and market trends across major LATAM countries.
  • Strategic & Financial Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts and financial modeling needed to assess partnership viability, structure favorable deals, and articulate the long‑term return on investment (ROI).
  • Exceptional Communication & Negotiation: Superior ability to influence, communicate, and negotiate with executive‑level stakeholders both internally and with external carrier partners.
  • Bilingual Proficiency: Fluency in Spanish and English is essential. Portuguese is a significant advantage, to effectively navigate business and cultural nuances in the region.
  • Networking and Relationship Capital: Existing strong relationships and a robust network within the executive and planning ranks of LATAM carrier accounts.
  • Ambition and Strategic Thinking: A proactive mindset focused on identifying and securing next‑generation opportunities and expanding GTT's strategic positioning, not just fulfilling immediate demand.

Core Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  • Negotiating: Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.
  • Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem‑solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Networking: Understanding the business value of creating mutually beneficial relationships with individuals outside of incumbent's own organization and ability to generate productive relationships with internal and external partners that improve access to resources and expertise.
  • Channel Sales: Knowledge of various channel sales strategies and solutions used to execute and fulfil a sales plan; ability to sell a hospitality organization's brand, products, and services through multiple and diverse avenues
  • Sales Proposals and Presentations: Knowledge of sales processes, tools, and techniques; ability to prepare and present formal recommendations for how the organization can meet the customer's needs.
  • Value Selling: Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product / service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer needs.

Universal Competencies

  • Continuous Improvement: Knowledge of transformation initiatives to drive fundamental changes, enhance responsiveness and efficiency to core business practices. Ability to drive cultural changes from best effort to results oriented.
  • Customer First (Customer Facing): Knowledge of internal customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting internal customer value creation at every level.
  • Operational Excellence: Understanding the system‑driven processes for consistency and scalability. Ability to re‑focus processes and systems from integration activity to maximizing a positive customer impact and anticipating future trends.

EEO statement

GTT provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, GTT complies with applicable state and local laws governing non‑discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

GTT expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of GTT’s employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em gestão de equipes de segurança.

  • Fluência em outro idioma.
